availableCommands.name: init

availableCommands.name: install-capability

availableCommands.name: locate
availableCommands.description: Find where something lives in the codebase, fast — a read-only subagent that fires its searches in parallel within a few rounds and returns only file:line ranges with a one-line reason each. availableCommands.name: research

availableCommands.name: review

availableCommands.name: security-review
